messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "time for blood levels to fall by half"
set: ["time for blood levels to fall by half", "check levels from time to time", "blood levels", "blood potassium levels", "blood cholesterol levels", "tamsulosin blood levels", "blood lipid levels", "inability to control blood sugar levels", "low blood sodium levels", "low blood sugar levels", "blood lipid levels regularly", "high blood sugar levels", "metoprolol levels in blood", "blood sugar levels in adults", "increase in blood sugar (glucose) levels", "high blood levels of uric acid"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
